title: Laddu, Chintu and the Runaway Baby Animals
moral: When big feelings come, take a deep breath, then choose a kind way.
description: It's Baby Animal Day in Masti Nagar, but Dadaji dozes off and Golu the goat munches the gate rope. ZIP! All the baby animals run away! Laddu feels cross, Chintu feels worried, and they learn to breathe through big feelings while finding the kitten, puppy, ducklings, calf and chick. Learn baby animal names in this funny animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.
outro: The End! Remember, friends: when big feelings come, take a deep breath, then choose a kind way. And Laddu? He is STILL asking... is it jalebi time yet? See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

narration.text: It's Baby Animal Day in Masti Nagar!
Dadaji was looking after the baby animals. A kitty, a doggy, a little cow, a chick and three tiny ducks!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Every baby animal has its very own special name. A baby cat is called a... a... zzzz.
Uh-oh! Dadaji fell asleep in the middle of his sentence! SNOOORE!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre! Is Baby Animal Day... also jalebi day?
Grumble, rumble went his tummy!

narration.text: Jingle, jingle! Who tiptoed in? Golu the goat!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
Munch, MUNCH! Golu ate the gate rope. CREEEAK! The gate swung open and ZIP! The babies ran away!
Laddu felt CROSS. Stomp, stomp! Chintu felt WORRIED. Spin, spin!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Oh no, oh no! What do we do?
Big feelings! Let's breathe together. Smell the flower... blow out the candle. Try it!
Phewww! Now we can think. Chalo!

narration.text: First, the sweet shop. Mmm... hot, sticky jalebis!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Jalebis! No, no, Laddu. Focus! FOCUS!
Meow! Something wiggled in the basket. The baby cat!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: I know! A baby cat is called a... CAT-LET!
Hee hee! Not cat-let! Do YOU know what a baby cat is called?

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: A KITTEN! A baby cat is a kitten!
The kitten licked Laddu's nose. Slurp! That tickles!

narration.text: At the lotus pond, three fluffy babies paddled with Mama Duck.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! I'll quack like a mama duck! QUACK, QUACK!
The babies just stared. Chintu's glasses slid off. Plop!
Golu tried too. Ba-a-a-a! Nope!
Then Laddu tripped and waddled, wibble, wobble, just like a duck! The babies paddled right behind him!
What is a baby duck called? Can you say it?
A DUCKLING! One, two, three ducklings! Wah!

narration.text: Woof, woof! Under the big banyan tree, a baby dog wanted to play chase!
Round and round the tree ran Laddu and Chintu... BONK!
Wibble, wobble, dizzy, dizzy!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Grrr! That doggy is too fast! I feel SO cross!
Then Laddu remembered. Smell the flower... blow out the candle. Phewww.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Here, little one. Come here, slowly.
Wag, wag! The baby dog trotted right up. A baby dog is called a PUPPY!

popups.sub: a baby dog is a puppy

narration.text: Moooo! In the green field stood Mama Cow. But where was her baby?

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: Leave it to Pinky!
Pinky gave her super-loud whistle. WHEEEET! A parrot tumbled off the mango tree!
And out of the tall grass skipped the baby cow!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: I know! A baby cow is called a... COW-LING!
Ha ha! Nope! What is a baby cow called? Do you know?

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: A CALF! A baby cow is a calf!
Mama Cow licked Pinky's whole face. SLUUURP!

narration.text: At sunset, everyone came home. But wait! Where was the baby hen?

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I was just resting my eyes! Now... where are my glasses?
His glasses were on his head! And... peep, peep! Look in his spare turban!
The baby hen was snuggled inside! A baby hen is called a CHICK!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! And a baby goat like Golu is called... a KID!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: A kid? But I'M a kid! Does that mean... I'm a baby goat?

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.text: That night, the babies were sleepy. Let's remember!
What is a baby cat called?
A kitten! Meow!
And what is a baby duck called?
A duckling! Quack! You're so clever!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: I felt worried, and Laddu felt cross. But we breathed, and then we could think!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Big feelings are okay. Breathe first, and then be kind.

narration.text: Then Masti Nagar had a Baby Animal Day party!
Chintu's glasses slipped off again. This time, he took a big breath, looked slowly, and found them!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Well done, dost! Breathe first, then think!
Uh-oh... munch, munch! Golu was eating the party banner!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre wah... now it's jalebi time!
